privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: SL is a small app for a friend group to bet fake coins on things. Here's what happens to your data, in plain language — not a legal document.
privacy.whatBody: Your email and a hashed password, or your name, email and picture from Google if you sign in that way; the display name and avatar you pick; and the bets, wagers and chat you post inside your team.
privacy.emailBody: We don't verify email addresses at sign-up — enter your own.
privacy.whereBody: Supabase stores the database and handles sign-in; Vercel hosts the app. Both process your data only to run SL. The only usage we track is which onboarding step people reach and whether an invite turned into a signup — nothing more specific than that, and no ads.
privacy.coinsBody: Coins have no cash value. They can't be bought, sold, withdrawn, or exchanged for anything real.
privacy.teamBody: A team's leader can remove or ban members from that team.
privacy.deleteBody: There's no self-serve way to delete your account yet. Ask the person who runs SL — team chat reaches them.
